text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew... You know, actually... Can I keep
going
like this?
choice_data_list: Shall we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have a feeling I'll learn more from
pushing
myself as hard as I can right
now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They say knowing your limits is the best
way to
improve, right? I'd like to find
out for myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may be right, but it's only natural
for me to
worry. It must show on my
face, because she fixes
me with a look.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll be running in more races from now
on, right? I
don't want to fall short in a
real race.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I want to stand my ground in a race, I
need to
stand my ground here. Let me
do this. Please.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is usually quite calm with
a gentle air about her, but right now, her
eyes are glowing
with a piercing
intensity.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I can't tell you how great it is
knowing
you're here beside me busting
your butt too.
choice_data_list: Let's keep it to where you won't c...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Please don't hold back. Work me to the
bone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Wonder Acute and I push
forward with
training until she's right on
the precipice of
exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you don't need to worry about
little old me.
I'll be able to handle it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And once we're done, we can kick back
and have
some tea. I bet you it'll be
extra delicious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and I continue training,
careful not
to go too hard.
